evals.prompt: I want to create a new Spice.ai Cloud app called 'analytics-prod' in the US West region, add a database secret, and deploy it. Walk me through the API calls.
evals.expected_output: Step-by-step: list regions, POST /v1/projects with region us-west-2 (legacy /v1/apps also works), POST secrets, POST deployments, check status

assertions.name: creates_app
assertions.description: Should show creating the project via API (canonical /v1/projects or legacy /v1/apps)

evals.prompt: How do I rotate my Spice.ai Cloud API keys without any downtime for my clients?
evals.expected_output: Use the dual-key system: regenerate secondary, update clients, then regenerate primary

assertions.name: explains_dual_key
assertions.description: Should explain the dual-key rotation system

evals.prompt: My Spice.ai Cloud project 123 runs in us-east-1. Make a copy of it in us-west-2 called analytics-west, with the same datasets, connections, and secrets, and get it running.
evals.expected_output: Fork the project with POST /v1/projects/123/forks and {"name": "analytics-west", "region": "us-west-2"} instead of recreating it by hand, check shared_state in the response, then deploy the fork with POST /v1/projects/{forkId}/deployments because a fork is not deployed on creation

assertions.name: forks_project
assertions.description: Should fork the source project rather than recreate it

assertions.name: targets_region
assertions.description: Should place the fork in us-west-2

assertions.name: deploys_fork
assertions.description: Should deploy the fork, which forking does not do

assertions.name: checks_shared_state
assertions.description: Should check the settings the fork shares with its source before deploying
